text: dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle 是 DeepSeek Harness 的工程与工作流技能包：它把 27 个技能注册到 Harness 技能目录，既可由模型调用，也可在 Web composer 输入 /技能名 使用。技能涵盖测试驱动开发、疑难故障诊断、代码审查、需求规格与工单整理、领域建模和方案访谈；按需读取对应技能正文，并提供资源目录供相对文件引用。适合希望在 DSH 中复用结构化编码、调试和规划流程的用户。代码未要求额外 API key 或外部账号。

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle adds 27 skills to DeepSeek Harness. Models can invoke them, and users can type /skill-name in the Web composer. Skills cover test-first development, bug diagnosis, code review, specifications, and tickets. Bodies load on demand; no API key is required.
想让 DSH 里的 agent 按测试先行的方式实现功能和修复 bug。
帮我在 DSH 里系统排查疑难故障或性能变慢的问题。
I want reusable DSH workflows for code review and turning a conversation into a project spec.
dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle 的「测试驱动开发」技能：指导 agent 以失败测试、最小实现的循环推进，并关注公共接口、测试接缝与反模式。可由模型调用或在 Web composer 输入 /tdd。
dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle 的「故障诊断」技能：针对疑难 bug 或性能回归，先建立能复现问题的反馈循环，再逐步收紧信号；可由模型调用或在 Web composer 输入 /diagnosing-bugs。
dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle：Matt Pocock's agent skills, packaged for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle：This bundle ships the 27 skills that upstream [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) promotes in its own plugin manifest (`skills/engineering` and `skills/productivity`), keeps every skill body and companion resource file intact, and registers them in the Harness skill registry under one provider named `mattpocock-skills`. Skill descriptions in the `/` menu and in the model's skill catalog are Chinese; every skill body stays in its upstream English.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · What it registers：- One skill provider: `mattpocock-skills`, source label `mattpocock-skills`, bundled precedence (rank 600).
- 27 skills, each under its upstream name, each with its own folder as the resource base directory.
- Every skill is both model-invocable (the `skill` tool and the session skill catalog) and user-invocable (`/skill-name` in the Web composer).

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · What it registers：Because the provider sits at bundled precedence, a project skill (`.dsh/skills/<name>`) or user skill (`~/.dsh/skills/<name>`) with the same name takes priority. That is the supported way to override one skill without forking the package.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Skills：Upstream marks user-invoked skills with `disable-model-invocation: true`. This port keeps every skill model-invocable, so the marker only records upstream's policy.

Full descriptions live in each `skills/<bucket>/<name>/SKILL.md` frontmatter and in `skills/index.json`; the Chinese text shown in the `/` menu and the skill catalog is stored in `i18n/zh.json` and carried in the manifest as `descriptionZh`.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Install：The repository is public, so the bundle installs straight from its URL. No npm account and no release asset are involved.

In the Web UI, open Settings, then Plugins, then Add plugin, and paste the repository URL:

```
https://github.com/sceatcher3/dsh-mattpocock-skills
```

From a terminal, the same URL goes straight to the plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sceatcher3/dsh-mattpocock-skills
```

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Install：The plugin manager reads `dsh.bundle.patch` from the repository, installs the package into the profile, and lists the row as `dsh-mattpocock-skills`; enable it if the install leaves it off.

The skill catalog is rebuilt on the next agent step, so a bundle that activates cleanly shows its skills in the session's available-skills list and in the `/` menu without a restart.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Install：If the install answers `restart-required` with `module-comparison`, the running process could not compare loaded plugin modules with their files. The bundle is still written to the profile; restart DSH once and the new module loads. That is the expected path when installing this package into an already running profile.

Two details keep the provider visible after a restart:

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Install：- `list()` is async on purpose. The registry wraps each `provider.list()` call with an abort-aware helper that calls `.then()` on the result whenever the caller passes an `AbortSignal` (the `skill` tool always does). A synchronous array is silently dropped with `skill provider "mattpocock-skills" skipped`.
- Registration already invalidates the catalog cache, so `apply()` only calls `ctx.skills.registerProvider()`.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Install：Offline verification against the real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` registry passes: 27 skills listed, `tdd` loads its full 3440-character body, with and without an `AbortSignal`.

To remove it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle
```

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Invoking a skill：- Model: `skill({ name: "tdd" })`.
- User: type `/tdd` (or any skill name) in the composer.
- Both routes return the same instructions, wrapped with a resource base directory. Relative references inside a skill (`tests.md`, `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`) resolve against that directory.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Layout：```
dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle/
  index.js                 provider registration
  cordis.patch.yml         bundle patch (one insert row)
  package.json             dsh.bundle.patch, exports, icon

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Invocation policy：Upstream ships 16 of the 27 skills as user-invoked only, meaning the model cannot pick them. This port deliberately widens the policy: the model may choose any of them, and the user can still call every one by name. Each entry in `skills/index.json` records the original flag as `upstreamModelInvocable`.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Invocation policy：To restore upstream behaviour, set `invocation.modelInvocable` to `false` for those entries in `skills/index.json` and restart the harness. Note that `tools/build-manifest.mjs` always writes the permissive policy, so re-running it resets a manual edit.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Upstream content: kept and dropped：Kept:

- Every `SKILL.md` exactly as published, including the `pr` skill's nested `metadata.credits` and `CREDITS.md`.
- All companion resources referenced by skill bodies: formats, templates, scripts, and pattern documents.

Dropped:

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Upstream content: kept and dropped：- The `in-progress` (7 skills) and `misc` (4 skills) buckets. Upstream does not promote them in its own plugin manifest; its README calls `in-progress` beta material.
- Each skill's `agents/openai.yaml`. That file carries Codex and Claude Code display and invocation metadata; the Harness registry receives the same information from this package's manifest.
- Upstream `docs/`, marketplace manifests, and install instructions for other agents.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Upstream content: kept and dropped：Where a skill mentions Claude Code conventions (`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/`, sub-agents), the text is preserved as published. Several skills already read or write `AGENTS.md`, and `setup-matt-pocock-skills` explicitly accepts either file.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Updating from upstream：```sh
git clone https://github.com/mattpocock/skills /tmp/mattpocock-skills
UPSTREAM_COMMIT=$(git -C /tmp/mattpocock-skills rev-parse HEAD) \
  node tools/sync-from-checkout.mjs /tmp/mattpocock-skills
```

dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Updating from upstream：The script reads the promoted skill list from the upstream `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, copies those skill folders (minus `agents/`), and regenerates `skills/index.json`. It reads `i18n/zh.json` before writing the manifest, so a newly promoted skill needs a Chinese description there; otherwise the script fails and names the missing skill. To regenerate only the manifest from the folders already present, run `node tools/build-manifest.mjs` or `npm run manifest`.
dsh-mattpocock-skills-bundle README · Updating from upstream：Review the diff, confirm that `skills/index.json` lists the expected skills, then reinstall or restart the bundle.
